title: Ribbon Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Ribbon Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands-incorporated SPAC listed on Nasdaq under ticker RIBB, filed a Form 8-K on April 13, 2026 announcing the adjournment of its Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders from April 13, 2026 to September 14, 2026. The adjournment was to allow additional time to solicit proxies. The record date for voting eligibility is February 18, 2026.
key_points: Ribbon Acquisition Corp. is a SPAC (Special Purpose Acquisition Company) incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed on Nasdaq
The Extraordinary General Meeting was adjourned from April 13, 2026 to September 14, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time
The adjournment was to allow additional time to solicit proxies for proposals in the proxy statement
Shareholders of record as of February 18, 2026 are entitled to vote at the adjourned meeting
Proxies previously submitted will be voted at the adjourned meeting unless properly revoked
The filing is signed by Angshuman (Bubai) Ghosh, Chief Executive Officer
